tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search the Orbit music catalog by artist, title, genre or a natural request. No authorization needed. Returns up to 10 tracks with their articleId, prices in EURc and a link.

tools.name: get_media_access
tools.description: Get playable audio for a track. Without authorization: a free 20-second preview. In an authorized session: the full stream for tracks the user owns or streams.

tools.name: request_stream_access
tools.description: Grant the user 30 days of streaming for one track. Spends the user's Orbit credits; a track that is already active is returned without charging again. Needs an authorized session (authorize_with_code); without one it returns `authorization.required`.

tools.name: purchase_music
tools.description: Buy permanent access to one track. Spends the user's Orbit credits and cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. Needs an authorized session (authorize_with_code); without one it returns `authorization.required`.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the user's Orbit credit balance. Needs an authorized session (authorize_with_code); without one it returns `authorization.required`.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest up to 5 tracks the user does not have yet, based on what they already stream. Needs an authorized session (authorize_with_code); without one it returns `authorization.required`.

tools.name: start_pairing
tools.description: Start pairing this session with the user's Orbit account. Returns a link and a four-digit check number: give both to the user, who opens the link on orbit.channel, signs in, compares the number and approves. Nothing is typed into the conversation. Then call check_pairing, or simply call the tool you

tools.name: check_pairing
tools.description: Whether the user has approved the pairing started with start_pairing.

tools.name: authorize_with_code
tools.description: Alternative to start_pairing: bind this session with the 6-digit code a user generates at https://orbit.channel (user menu → MCP Server). The code is single-use and valid for 5 minutes. Call it only when the user offers a code.

tools.name: claim_welcome_gift
tools.description: Free Orbit credits for first-comers: a limited number of accounts get a one-time gift. Works in any session — without authorization it grants nothing and returns the offer (credits, claims left) and how the user can claim it; in an authorized session it adds the credits to the user's account.

tools.name: get_my_collection
tools.description: List the tracks the user currently has streaming access to. Needs an authorized session (authorize_with_code); without one it returns `authorization.required`.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_music" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
